g01_ring_dswap.description: D inputs of ring head flops O0[0] (_835_) and O0[1] (_836_) swapped

g02_xor_to_xnor_405.description: datapath cell _405_ xor2_1 replaced by xnor2_1

g04_buf_O0_0.description: buf_1 inserted on the O0[0] flop output (models resizer buffering)

g05_clkbuf.description: all flops clocked through one clkbuf_1 (models a post-CTS netlist)

g06_dffn_S3.description: S[3] flop replaced by a negative-edge dffnq_1

s_m07_first_load_no_accum_en.description: mapped GF180 netlist of RTL mutant m07_first_load_no_accum_en (first load ignores accum_en: head cleared whenever first && bit_sel==7 (e.g. DIV states with last = 0))

s_m14_rare_W_A5_b3.description: mapped GF180 netlist of RTL mutant m14_rare_W_A5_b3 (rare value: accumulate term off by one when W == 0xA5 and bit_sel == 3 and the v bit is set)

s_m21_bit_on_no_accum_en.description: mapped GF180 netlist of RTL mutant m21_bit_on_no_accum_en (accumulate bit ignores accum_en: v bits add to the head in IDLE/CMD/DIV states)

s_m15_rare_qi_80.description: mapped GF180 netlist of RTL mutant m15_rare_qi_80 (rare value: score qi == -128 treated as +128)

s_e01_plus_adder.description: mapped GF180 netlist of RTL mutant e01_plus_adder (shared adder written with + instead of ripple_add)
